item.title: Microsoft Teams: Configure a list of allowed external meeting notetaker bots for your Teams meetings
item.description:
Admins will be able to configure granular controls in Teams Admin Center for managing external meeting bots and their access to meetings hosted in their organization.


GA date: January CY2027
